title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.coprime_one_left_iff
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.coprime_one_left_iff` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.coprime_one_left_iff : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Iff (Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.gcd (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) x0) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) True)

evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- coprime_one_left_iff 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.coprime_one_left_iff[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate, which re-checks the constructed proof term against the stated type: `gcd 1 n` divides `1` directly (`gcd_dvd_left`), so `eq_one_of_dvd_one` gives `gcd 1 n = 1` unconditionally; the `Iff` with `True` is immediate (`True.intro` forward, the equation itself backward). `nat_theorem_inventory` exits non-zero for a name that does not exist, and the `grep -c` requires the admitted declaration to be printed.

evidence.supports: axiom_footprint: [] -- the Nat prelude's trusted surface is empty
evidence.notes: `nat_axiom_inventory --require-axiom-free nat` enumerates the built Nat environment and exits non-zero unless it admits no Axiom, Opaque or Quotient declaration. A theorem cannot depend on a trusted declaration the environment does not contain, so an empty trusted surface bounds every individual theorem's footprint by [].

provenance.source: statement-only extraction of the Mathlib proposition from Mathlib v4.30.0 (see prior_art), independently proved here as `Nat.coprime_one_left_iff` and admitted through `Kernel::add_declaration`

prior_art.attribution: the proposition was read from the pinned statement-only inventory; the proof term and tactic trace were not consulted

notes: `Nat.Coprime` has no separate name in this kernel's Nat prelude (matching `Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime`'s established convention); it is spelled inline as `gcd _ _ = 1`, so `formal.statement` is the actual kernel-core `render_lean` output for `Nat.coprime_one_left_iff`, not the Mathlib surface form named in `title`. `depends_on` restricts to entries that already carry a fact ledger entry.
